title: Kirby Problem 1.75
exact_target: Find a knot energy with no nongreat-circle unknot critical points, together with a gradient flow that explicitly retracts the entire smooth unknot space onto the great circles.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2734 (KP-1.75). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman, eds., \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 1.75 and its remarks; Chapters 1 and 2 for the stated conventions.
